Tell it as a story. A shop buys stock and pays 18,000 rupees of GST. It can get that back as input tax credit, but only if every record agrees: the supplier reports the sale, the tax on the bill is right, and the bill is paid within 180 days. One mismatch and the money is gone. Today an accountant checks this by hand in Excel. Scale: 1.67 crore GST businesses, 35,132 crore of fake credit caught in seven months, and since Oct 2025 the rules are stricter.
